o.text:
Probably from Armenian փնթի (pʻntʻi, “slovenly, untidy”) or Persian پنتی (penti), پینتی (pinti).
Compare also Mamluk Kipchak [script needed] (pinti, “wretched, helpless”), and Ottoman Turkish پنتی (penti, pinti, “stingy”).
From Russian грипп (gripp), from French grippe.
Calque of French eau de Javel. Izafet II compound of Javel + su.
